# The Workspace Company Raider 5090 offer — SRC-0275

## Sources

- https://www.theworkspacecompany.com/en/shop/raider-16-max-hx-b2wj-039be-msi-raider-16-max-hx-b2wj-039be-intel-core-ultra-9-290hx-plus-1-tb-geforce-rtx-5090-azerty-3774
- https://www.theworkspacecompany.com/en/productgarantie
- https://www.theworkspacecompany.com/en/terms-conditions

The exact page displays €4123 including VAT for Belgian AZERTY `B2WJ-039BE`, 32GB/1TB and RTX 5090. A hidden/indexed €3407.44 value equals €4123 divided by 1.21 and is therefore the ex-VAT amount despite confusing page labelling; it is not a consumer discount.

The page permits cart entry and promises free delivery, but does not state stock quantity or warranty duration. The warranty page covers diagnosed manufacturing hardware defects through a repair partner and excludes software, wear, accident and battery ageing; it does not promise a third year. The company's terms are oriented toward employer/cafeteria-plan orders and allow cancellation for supplier stock, employer approval or obvious price/specification errors. Treat €4123 as a real displayed gross lead, not a purchase-cleared three-year transaction.
